sender: Priya Natarajan, Corporate Access, Halvorsen & Pike Securities
subject: Fri 10:30am ET call: ex-VP Product, enterprise endpoint-management vendor - Windows 11 fleet data and Mac share of new enrollments (4 seats; confirm by 5pm Thurs)
body:
Hi Ellen,

We have lined up a small-group call for Friday ahead of the late-October prints. It touches both of your Microsoft and Apple positions. Only four slots; confirmation needed by 5pm Thursday so I can release unused seats.

Guest: Former VP of Product at a mid-sized enterprise endpoint-management (MDM/UEM) vendor (left in August after 9 years). The company manages roughly 11,000 enterprise tenants and about 38m endpoints, split across Windows, macOS and mobile. She retains read access to aggregated, anonymized fleet-level benchmarks as a consultant and can share what she saw through September.

What she told us in pre-screening:
- Windows 11 reached roughly 79% of managed Windows endpoints by end-September, vs. about 64% a year ago. Her view is that this is ahead of the pace most IT leaders had budgeted, and that the commercial refresh cycle is still running rather than fading.
- Copilot+ PC-class devices are now about 17% of new Windows enrollments, up from the low single digits in the spring. About 40% of those tenants also bought or piloted M365 Copilot seats in the same quarter, which she called the clearest pairing she has seen.
- macOS share of new device enrollments rose to about 24% from roughly 19% a year ago, driven by financial services and professional services clients standardizing on Apple silicon for mixed fleets. She sees this as additive, not substitutive, so Windows enrollments grew too.
- Mac refresh deals are slightly more likely to be bundled with Apple Business Manager and Apple Intelligence-enabled MDM controls.

Topics:
- How reliable fleet data is as a proxy for hardware shipments and Microsoft commercial licensing
- Customers most likely to slow in 2027
- Windows 11 migration tail and 365 seat attach rates
- Where Apple Intelligence and Copilot are or are not driving buying decisions

Logistics: Friday 10:30-11:15am ET, dial-in sent upon confirmation. Compliance pre-cleared. She will not discuss her former employer's non-public financials or any non-anonymized client data.

Best,
